purpose: Confirm frozen multi-step Accel rules on fresh initial states and execution noise; preserve all original tasks and the 32-view disturbance baseline.

population.seed_rule: First 8 SHA256 hex digits of namespace|task|split|index, modulo 2147000000, plus 20000; freeze before any new policy outcome.
population.novelty_claim: New initial-state and noise samples of known tasks within existing official scene splits; NOT new-task or entirely unseen-kitchen generalization.
population.deduplication: Check registered prior task/split/seeds and physical snapshot identities before admission; no success-based replacement. Record all generation failures and stop for review.

development_rules.old_40_role: Exploration/development for this new confirmation, without altering original seen/heldout metadata or historical receipts.
development_rules.capacity: Old development canonical-view mean success, after averaging execution noise and initials.
development_rules.view_loss: Old development canonical success minus mean success over the original 32 extra_eval views.
development_rules.group_caveat: These thresholds organize descriptive strata, not a sufficient-condition theorem or eligibility filter. Development has only two initials per task/split; report continuous capacity/view-loss values, uncertainty and group transfer failures.

probing.metric: Original native Accel prefix3; original per-model action dimensions and Flow settings.
probing.first_window_admission: Independent initial scoring pass must exactly reproduce window1 noise/input/velocity/actions and selection for the new population, separately for each model.
probing.stopping: Five actual scores; success events recorded but not used for selection. Actual terminated/truncated still fail closed; no imputation.
probing.camera_semantics: Original linked exterior installation offset, wrist installation unchanged, native support motion; not physically actuated head-camera control.
probing.reset_semantics: Candidate probes reset to the same frozen initial state; subsequent complete-task evaluations also start from that initial state.

complete_task_evaluation.deduplication: Identical chosen view shares the same initial/model/noise result; never retain the better duplicate.
complete_task_evaluation.execution_pairing: Pair each new execution repeat and replan-index address across all evaluated views; preserve original model-specific replan stride and task horizons.

analysis.primary: Window3 minus uniform mean over original 32 extra_eval views, all tasks retained; per-model seen/heldout reports and overall average.
secondary: Continuous development capacity/view-loss versus confirmation gains
analysis.uncertainty: Paired task/initial hierarchical intervals with paired resampling of new execution addresses; preserve repeated observations and shared layouts; label multi-window/subgroup exploration and control multiplicity for formal significance claims.
analysis.scale_caveat: Four new initials per task/split improves the original two, but is a bounded confirmation, not guaranteed power or a final benchmark-scale result.

execution.queue: Existing durable execution queue, dynamic small blocks, immutable artifacts, explicit ownership and missing-only recovery.
gates: New snapshot and candidate rendering admission
Both-host actual inference and reset/anchor pilot
Freeze group manifest and selected-view manifest before confirmation endpoint reveal
execution.rollout_timing: Pending actual dual-host end-to-end pilot; 47-70 seconds per rollout is a planning scenario, not a measured promise for the new panel.
execution.runtime_adapter_status: Not yet implemented for fresh initial populations. Current short_view_probe anchors to the old panel; it must not be pointed at new seeds without new standalone-score admission.
